entries.why: Frozen with validation not_evaluable because the parser dropped the printed values (PROVENANCE.md, 'batch_all parts'). The unit cell 'm\uf057' was glued to the next row's 'VGS' by Symbol-font spaces (U+F020); page_words now splits it. The 4.5 V / 68 A row reads typ 2.6 / max 3.2 mOhm and the 10 V / 68 A row (previously dropped) typ 1.9 / max 2.4 mOhm. The curves are ID = 86 A, so both anchors are evaluated at approximate conditions (86/68 = 1.26, inside the 0.75..1.34 window): chart 3.027 mOhm at 4.5 V and 2.279 mOhm at 10 V on the 25 C curve, both consistent. No curve, point, readout or calibration changes; status stays review_required (its reason changes from validation_not_evaluable to validation_consistent_at_approximate_conditions).
